entries.annotation: Native common hook fields: conversation, root transcript, current prompt id and worker attribution.
PreToolUse and PostToolUse inputs and generator dispatch; Post includes unmodified native result.
Tool caller exhausts PostToolUse hook generator before returning the tool result.
Native hook generator dispatch awaits the configured hook chain.
Command hook executor awaits E1 before interpreting success or failure.
Only explicitly async/asyncRewake configuration backgrounds this command path.
Synchronous hook waits for child exit and stream processing; normal return versus bounded failure.
Configured hooks are drained through an awaited asynchronous iterator.
Stop snapshot retains in-flight tasks, then yields the Stop hook chain.
Task snapshot filter accepts running/pending and excludes explicitly foreground tasks.
Explicit asynchronous Bash returns backgroundTaskId even in local already-completed branch.
Asynchronous Agent returns isAsync/status/agentId after dispatching worker.
Foreground Agent moved to background also returns async launch result.
TaskStop resolves exact task, checks running/type/owner, invokes type-specific kill and returns resolved ID.
TaskStop successful result shape; remote-shell success text has different guarantees and is excluded.
Removal suppresses content for dropped_by_hook; optional commandUuid and deliveryId only.
ll forwards directly to enqueuePendingNotification, without adding UUID.
Resume plugin/function-hook denial returns before delivery commit or resumed execution.
Interactive host installs Mqe and wires g8 with joined run IDs and delivery callback.
Resumed sidechain user message includes joined run identities and notification origin.
Worker pass finalization and owner-notification boundary after stream ends; parked duration has other semantics.
Resumed-worker execution; owner-notification policy and dispatch lifetime differ from delivery commit.
Interactive root duration append after turn-end handling/reset loading; may defer for agents/detached work.
Agent TaskStop differs from shell: worker kill can notify owner; shell no-root rule cannot generalize.
Notification envelope fields are structural task/tool/status metadata, not inferred prose.
SendMessage successful resume can expose resumedAgentId/revivedAgentId; fresh live mapping not established.
Alternate runner wake-router branch may requeue stopped-agent notices to root; not simply terminal discard.
Actual tool-result withdrawal caller is gated GetTask, not assumed TaskOutput. It receives taskId and requeues the notice if its signal aborts; tool is disabled in this surface.
Shell completion registers withdrawal callback only when task snapshot feature is enabled.
Normal blockable end-turn caller exhausts Stop/SubagentStop generator before continuing.
Loop-tick end-turn caller exhausts Stop hook generator; nonblocking errors do not block provider progress.
